name: Draft marks in Activity and Channels
author: wizard
description: With Channels on, an Activity row whose thread has a saved, unsent draft says "✎ Draft" ahead of its last message, and a channel in the Channels list whose message box holds one wears the same pencil, so you can see where you left words half-typed. Words, an attached file or a reply card all count; the mark comes with the first keystroke and goes on send or discard, without a reload (wizard-ux issue 1445).
